notes: Inbound: dev form + emailed dev@emberbyte.gg after trying free tier; interested in hosted API for fast iteration
Summary: mobile+PC social game (asymmetric PvP). Core feature: in-game chat with LLM-driven NPC banter and quick player-support responses. Need streaming + websocket friendly endpoint.
PoV: small engineering team (proto in Node + Unity), want low friction SDKs, fast time-to-value. AE Miguel followed up with config doc and pricing sheet.
Latency target: 95th pct <150ms for short chat prompts (system+user ~150 tokens typical). Prefer <100ms if possible for turn-based feel. Concerned about network variance on mobile.
Throughput: initial concurrency ~200 RPS during peak events, average lower. Plan to scale with spikes during promotions.

Abuse controls: must block toxic/harassing content in public channels. Want both pre-moderation options (synchronous filter hook) and streaming moderation markers. Also need per-user rate-limits and per-session anti-spam heuristics.

Cost sensitivity: high. Running chat-heavy features vs. player ARPU — want batching, prefix caching, and more aggressive token limits. Asked about quantized model variants and fallback routing to cheaper models on high load.
Model preferences: open to open-weight models (Llama family-like) for cost predictability; also explored hosted fine-tuning for NPC personality. Asked about Redwood model catalog + perf profiles.
Security: SOC2 not required today but want SSO for admin console, audit logs for moderation incidents, and retention controls for chat transcripts.
Quote from CTO (call 3/2): 'We can't ship chat that lets players harass others. Moderation has to be near-real-time.'
Procurement: small legal review; standard T&Cs OK. No enterprise procurement yet.
Self-serve steps taken: signed up, tested streaming sample, validated token usage on dev cluster. Hit rate limits during stress test — asked about burst capacity and quota increases.
Tech ask: example websocket streaming config, sample moderation webhook flow, recommended batching/cache settings for session-based conversations, sample cost calc for 200 RPS peak.
Internal: AE Miguel -> intro to SE Leah; planning SE deep-dive + lightweight POC (2-week) on hosted API. POC acceptance criteria: moderation accuracy, 95p latency <150ms, cost < $X per MAU (TBD).
Follow-ups: Leah to send POC template + e2e config; schedule SRE call if latency can't be achieved in hosted demo.
